messages:
maria: Quick UX review from today's sync: a few routing-editor issues stood out — priority numbers feel detached in compact rows, inline validation obscures the preview scrubber, and keyboard reorder doesn't announce destination. Who can take these?
charlie: Saw the priority number alignment issue. In compact rows the number uses a separate grid column so it visually drifts when text wraps. Suggest pinning the number to the left with fixed width.
anya: Repro. Also the inline validation pill floats above the preview scrubber at small widths and blocks clicks. We should re-anchor it or collapse to an icon in narrow layouts.
kevin: Quick fixes: give priority number a fixed 36px slot to avoid drift; change validation pill to a condensed icon + tooltip below 640px so it doesn't overlap the scrubber.
lydia: A11y: screenreader currently says "dragging" but nothing like "moved to position 3 of 6". Add aria-live polite announcer on reorder complete with format: "Rule 'X' moved to position Y of Z." Also ensure keyboard-reorder exposes a logical focus target.
maria: Copy nit for empty preview: current "No matching routes" -> prefer: "No routing rules match this input." Maybe add a help link "Create a rule" that opens the composer.
charlie: UX micro: priority numbers should be tabbable for keyboard users and reveal a small context menu with move up/down actions. That reduces reliance on drag.
anya: I'll prototype fixed-number slot + condensed validation icon. Can also add a little chevron toggle on the preview scrubber to hide the legend.
kevin: I'll do the aria-live and keyboard focus changes in the reorder logic and add unit tests for announcer text. Also will re-anchor validation to avoid overlay.
lydia: I'll run a screenreader pass after PRs land and post failing utterances for QA.
ux-bot: Checklist: update design spec with fixed-number slot, add unit test for aria announcement, add responsive rule for validation pill -> icon under 640px. :white_check_mark:
maria: Thanks  can we aim these small fixes for next sprint? Tagging for planning. :rocket:
